title: PERF — Reduce ClipDetection timeout 900s→300s to save 10min when Ollama is down
rationale: scs001-live 7:00 and 18:00 CET runs: ViralDownloader returned some clips → ClipDetection ran → Ollama unavailable → timeout at 900s. Sprint 1356 fallback fires after timeout, producing content. But the 15-min wait is wasteful. ClipDetection input is capped to 20 clips × concurrency 4 = 5 batches × ~30s/clip = 150s normal run. 300s = 2× buffer. When Ollama is down, reduces wasted time from 15min to 5min.

tasks.description: In agents/scs001-orchestrator/index.ts: reduce STAGE_TIMEOUTS['3-clip-detection'] from 900_000 to 300_000.
